bounded_host_request.command:
set -euo pipefail
root="$(git rev-parse --show-toplevel)"
app="$root/.worktrees/profile-live-20261114"
compose="$app/deploy/gserver-compose.yaml"
expected="sha256:154501363ed5c7dd9bcfa66a506450410ccec76553fc08b117aec0e903e4c60a"
current="$(docker inspect --format '{{.Image}}' deploy-gaybbs-1)"
tagged="$(docker image inspect --format '{{.Id}}' gace-tgtumbler-gaybbs:local)"
test "$current" = "$expected" && test "$tagged" = "$expected" || exit 70
test "$(docker inspect --format '{{.State.Running}}' deploy-gaybbs-1)" = true || exit 71
test -r "$root/deploy/secrets/db_password.txt" && test -r "$root/deploy/secrets/bot_token.txt" || exit 72
test -r "$compose" || exit 73
tmp="$(mktemp -d)"
trap 'rm -rf "$tmp"' EXIT
gh run download 43575207353 --repo seigo-gace/GateApp-Bot --name gaybbs-profile-bundle --dir "$tmp" >/dev/null
test "$(sha256sum "$tmp/gaybbs.mjs" | cut -d' ' -f1)" = "ba28ae41460708fe36dc77c0766000d12d0c55b9a6b95df333da99caadcaed11" || exit 74
printf 'FROM gace-tgtumbler-gaybbs:local\nCOPY --chown=1000:1000 gaybbs.mjs /app/gaybbs.mjs\n' > "$tmp/Dockerfile"
docker build --network none --pull=false -t gace-tgtumbler-gaybbs:invite-c993c89 -f "$tmp/Dockerfile" "$tmp" >/dev/null
docker run --rm --network none --entrypoint node gace-tgtumbler-gaybbs:invite-c993c89 --check /app/gaybbs.mjs >/dev/null
candidate="$(docker image inspect --format '{{.Id}}' gace-tgtumbler-gaybbs:invite-c993c89)"
printf 'secrets:\n  db_password:\n    file: %s\n  bot_token:\n    file: %s\n' "$root/deploy/secrets/db_password.txt" "$root/deploy/secrets/bot_token.txt" > "$tmp/override.yaml"
docker compose -p deploy -f "$compose" -f "$tmp/override.yaml" config -q >/dev/null
docker tag gace-tgtumbler-gaybbs:local gace-tgtumbler-gaybbs:rollback-invite-c993c89
docker tag gace-tgtumbler-gaybbs:invite-c993c89 gace-tgtumbler-gaybbs:local
rollback(){ docker tag gace-tgtumbler-gaybbs:rollback-invite-c993c89 gace-tgtumbler-gaybbs:local; docker compose -p deploy -f "$compose" -f "$tmp/override.yaml" up -d --no-deps --force-recreate gaybbs >/dev/null 2>&1 || true; }
if ! docker compose -p deploy -f "$compose" -f "$tmp/override.yaml" up -d --no-deps --force-recreate gaybbs >/dev/null;then rollback;exit 81;fi
sleep 7
actual="$(docker inspect --format '{{.Image}}' deploy-gaybbs-1 2>/dev/null || echo absent)"
running="$(docker inspect --format '{{.State.Running}}' deploy-gaybbs-1 2>/dev/null || echo false)"
if test "$actual" != "$candidate" || test "$running" != true;then rollback;exit 82;fi
{ echo "COMMUNITY_INVITE_DEPLOY=PASS";echo "SOURCE_HEAD=c993c89f0cba3e11980dd71c8c254812f62045c3";echo "IMAGE=$actual";echo "RUNNING=true";echo "ROLLBACK_IMAGE=$expected";} | gh issue comment 7 --repo seigo-gace/GateApp-Bot --body-file - >/dev/null
